expected_outputs.note: produced_by id-references are stable across path renames; legacy path-based linkage still works for v1.0.

handoff.note: Server-computed fields overwrite any user-supplied values on upload.

formulas.ssim: score field as-is, capped at 0.3 contribution

metrics.guidance: Prefer numerical metrics computed on actual values over visual similarity. Image shape is easy to fake; computational results are not. SSIM contributions are clipped to 0.3 in result_fidelity.

scorecard.result_fidelity_formula: mean(deviations.score), with SSIM contributions clipped to 0.3 before averaging

recorder.install: git clone <repo> && cd tools/trace-record && bash install.sh

modes.live: PostToolUse hooks (Claude Code) / plugin (OpenCode) / git pre-commit (Cursor) / post-tool hook (OpenClaw) emit ARM steps as you work.
modes.post_hoc: Convert an existing native session log to trace.jsonl with `trace-record convert --tool auto --in <session>`.

recorder.name: trace-record
recorder.preflight: Run `trace-record validate trace/trace.jsonl` before bundling — mirrors the server checks above.
recorder.purpose: Produce ARM v1.1 compliant trace/trace.jsonl from native session logs of common agentic IDEs/CLIs.

checks.description: Every step must declare step_type in {thought,tool_call,tool_result,artifact,decision,error,observation}.
Each tool_call must have a matching tool_result with the same tool_call_id.
Step timestamps must fall within execution.ran_at ± wall_time_s.
Step_type=artifact rows must reference paths that exist in the bundle.
Total cost_usd must clear a 0.01 floor.
At least one step body must be greppable (substring) in execution/run.log.
